name: switch
description: `id` is omitted: set part ids through the root `ids` prop so Ark's internal lookups keep working.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: checked
props.description: The controlled checked state of the switch

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the switch is disabled.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the switch. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: If `true`, the switch is marked as invalid.

props.name: label
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: name
props.description:

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Function to call when the switch is clicked.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the switch is read-only

props.name: required
props.description: If `true`, the switch input is marked as required,

props.name: value
props.description: The value of switch input. Useful for form submission.
